parent.recipe: m1 template: Muon lr peak 0.01, wd 0.02, momentum 0.95, nesterov, NS5 (3.4445,-4.775,2.0315), eps 1e-7, adjust_lr original; aux AdamW lr 0.01 betas (0.9,0.95) eps 1e-8 wd 0.02; warmup 32 + cosine to 0.1x peak; grad clip 1.0; data p=0.5 manifest seed 3101

branches.batch_stream: same MixtureStream/build_step_manifest continuation as parent (p=0.5, manifest seed 3101); identical across arms
branches.rng: restored from parent checkpoint, advanced identically across arms
branches.lr_schedule: parent schedule evaluated at absolute step index; multipliers apply to the scheduled value
branches.eval: m0 dev pools A_dev/B_dev (256-token windows); primary = v_q = 0.5*(NLL_A+NLL_B) at branch end

invariants.update_norm: every arm norm-matched per matrix to ||NS5(u)||_F (operator contract)

gates.runner_smoke: 2-step branch on CPU or idle GPU, asserts shapes/norm logs/eval path
gates.native_replay: restore parent step-512, execute step 513 with native arm, compare train loss to parent's recorded step-513 loss; must match to < 1e-12; else STOP and diagnose
gates.gpu_gate: V16 GPU tasks terminated + GPU0 shared-access approved + replay passed + this config frozen + estimate <= 1 GPU-hour
